description:
At Bubba Cool, we transform pet photos into stunning personalized art, offering unique designs across a variety of products like canvas prints, home decor, and accessories. Our mission is to celebrate the love between pets and their owners through meaningful and high-quality creations.

What makes us stand out? Our range of 8 distinct artistic styles and the ability to print on more than 10 product types ensure there's something for every pet lover. Our products are cherished as gifts or keepsakes, bringing joy to homes worldwide.

As an affiliate, you'll earn a generous US$20 commission on every sale you generate, with transparent tracking and timely payments to support your efforts. Whether you're a pet influencer, blogger, or enthusiast, partnering with Bubba Cool means aligning with a brand that pet owners trust and adore.

Sign up today to share in the success and help pet lovers everywhere turn their memories into art!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to BubbaCool! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as the merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and as an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliates might or might not be assigned a coupon code, with details and usage clarified on your Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may also advertise the merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or on offline channels such as classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website and you will receive a commission, which is calculated based on the Commission Structure. The commission amount is dependent on order value and does not include extra fees (such as tax or shipping costs).

Commission Structure & Modifications:
BubbaCool.com reserves the right to modify, change, or discontinue the Affiliate Program commission rate, payment terms, or any other aspect of the program at any time, at its sole discretion, with or without prior notice. The current standard commission is $20 per qualifying sale, unless otherwise specified in writing. Any changes to commission rates will become effective immediately upon being posted on this page or communicated via email or dashboard notification. Continued participation in the Affiliate Program after any such changes shall constitute your consent to the revised terms.

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify your payment details in Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. The use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. The status of commissions is displayed in the Commission tab; any paid commission will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional materials such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tools tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on your affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also get a network commission, which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share your network link. Any affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become your downline affiliate.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them and can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

The cookie duration is stated in the Affiliate registration form. The tracking period will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie period, every order made by this customer at the merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (there’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link each time).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@bubbacool.com
